changelog: **Klaviyo pull connector (read-only):** a MARKETING organization's ADMIN pastes a read-only Klaviyo private key on `/admin/integrations` (test → save → pause/resume → sync now → dry-run preview → disconnect; `/api/admin/integrations/klaviyo/**`, ADMIN of a MARKETING org only, the org always the session's). Every Klaviyo profile becomes a lead every 15 minutes (`initKlaviyoSyncCron`, a `JobLease` per connection, per-connection backoff 15 min → 6 h, `Retry-After` honoured): a page of profiles runs through the shared `runImport` engine — linked profile → update, address of an existing lead/account → adopt, else a new account + stand-in lead + funnel record at the first stage through the marketing import's own create-only writer (new `createMarketingAccountsBatch`, one planning pass per page; `manualAccountsTable`). Re-syncs fill gaps only (`planFieldUpdates`, non-authoritative); location, custom properties and the Klaviyo consent are kept on the new `ExternalProfileLink` (bounded JSON text) and shown as information on the account page — a consent never becomes a contact permission. Source via `leadSourceName()`, which gains a `vendor` step (affiliate > UTM > vendor > channel): `klaviyo:<method>/<form or list>`. The first import is silent (one aggregated activity line); later runs ring the owner's bell once with a count (`integration.newLeads`). The key is sealed with `secretBox` and never returned (last four only). New tables `ExternalConnection`, `ExternalProfileLink` (both in `TENANT_MODELS`); companies list filter `?source=klaviyo`; the rollback CLI treats the link as machine-written. A second person of an existing account (matched by its name, in the same page or a later sync) is linked without a lead of their own and never fills the account's contact, lead or first-touch source; an erased person's links become tombstones (`ExternalProfileLink.erasedAt`, found by lead or `emailHash`, wired into `anonymizeUser`/`hardDeleteUser`/`forgetCompanyContact` through `src/lib/externalProfileErasure.ts`) that every later sync skips; a profile that ERRORED holds the next query's `since` (`profilesErrorFloor`, at most 3 queries); saving a different key restarts the query as a quiet first import; the bell links a sales rep to `/sales/accounts`. Never writes to Klaviyo; never mails a lead. API revision pinned to `2026-07-15`. `docs/integrations/klaviyo.md`.

en: Connect Klaviyo with a read-only key: every profile becomes a lead on your pipeline and stays in sync every 15 minutes — nothing is written back and no lead is e-mailed.
tr: Klaviyo’yu salt okunur bir anahtarla bağlayın: her profil satış hattınızda bir potansiyel müşteri olur ve 15 dakikada bir eşitlenir — geri hiçbir şey yazılmaz, potansiyel müşterilere e-posta gitmez.
de: Verbinden Sie Klaviyo mit einem nur lesenden Schlüssel: Jedes Profil wird ein Lead in Ihrer Pipeline und bleibt alle 15 Minuten synchron — nichts wird zurückgeschrieben, kein Lead wird angeschrieben.
